name: Apollo 5 LM
about: Apollo 5 LM (1968-007A), a crewed vehicle (LM AS), launched 1968 Jan 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Jan 22), held fixed
